ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to Food Science & Human Nutrition majors on Monday, April 15, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Technical Systems Management students on Monday, April 22, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. BUSINESS MINOR/PROSPECTIVE BUSINESS MINOR STUDENTS: This section will not open to you since all students are required to take the online option, if offered, as stated on the Business Minor website.
